dex.entry: Glostrael's rare apex kindling — a vast lantern-bell leviathan the old quay-folk call the living lighthouse. Its golden core burns steady as a beacon and its eight tendrils trail star-bright orbs that mark safe water for miles. Sailors of Dimglass swear the Long Dusk never fully settles over a bay a

art.silhouette: Immense translucent bell-jelly like a cathedral lantern; stained-glass panes of gold light in an aqua-blue dome, a blazing warm beacon-core at the crown that sweeps slow beams; eight long tendrils each ending in a bright pearl-orb like a hung star; drifting, weightless, regal at 64px.

art.direction: The rare surf catch grows into a literal lighthouse — the bay it loves never goes dark.
